content.journey: J04 — Gestão de Colaboradores, Convites e Permissões
methods: UI-first owner invite creation/cancellation and recovery signup in isolated collaborator Chromium; no association inserted outside supported flow
Directed inspection of five requested screens/components plus actual RPC/RLS/grants and membership FK/trigger contracts
Two explicitly separated technical negative calls as unassociated collaborator: self-role attempt denied; synthetic owner email lookup returned no rows
Superpowers systematic diagnosis/verification and scoped migrations-rls-contracts; no implementation or broad audit

scenarios.name: Descoberta da equipe
scenarios.observed: Equipe found in navigation; listing fails on relationship and misrepresents owner as zero people.

scenarios.name: Criação de convite
scenarios.observed: Empty contacts rejected; malformed email persisted then cancelled; valid cowboy invite generated for synthetic collaborator. Link sharing required; no email message sent by this UI.

scenarios.name: Aceitação e ingresso
scenarios.observed: Anonymous preview 401; recovery UI signup created intended collaborator and separate persistent session. Authenticated preview 200/is_valid=true still shown expired due array/object mismatch; acceptance not available; zero membership inserted.

scenarios.name: Convites pendentes
scenarios.observed: Pending contact/role/creation/expiry visible after reload; cancellation by UI returned 204 and server state cancelled. Authenticated cancelled/nonexistent links both rendered generic expired screen. Used/real-expiry/refusal not exercised because no acceptance or waiting/manipulation.

scenarios.name: Alteração de papel
scenarios.reason: Member list fails and collaborator has no accepted membership; no direct association created to simulate success.

scenarios.name: Permissões operacionais do colaborador
scenarios.reason: No cowboy/manager membership exists, so navigation as those roles would be a false certification.

scenarios.name: Papéis por fazenda
scenarios.reason: Horizonte acceptance blocked; manager ingress in Controle deferred rather than generating another unfinished grant.

scenarios.name: Administração e recuperação
scenarios.observed: Duplicate pending invitation and invite to existing owner both created through UI; both extras cancelled without accepting. Double click generated one request. Unassociated collaborator self-role technical attempt denied; scoped contact negative returned zero rows. These checks do not substitute role-specific UI testing.

scenarios.name: Responsividade
scenarios.observed: Owner team/invite/role selector and invitation error views exercised in 1440x900/390x844; no horizontal overflow in recorded observations. Successful acceptance/member role-edit layouts unavailable.

findings.preconditions: Original owner, Horizonte, existing accepted owner membership
reproduction: Compare empty screen and error with persisted owner membership
findings.expected: Load farm members or present recoverable loading error without implying zero people
findings.observed: PGRST relationship failure for user_fazendas/user_profiles; UI shows 0 people and empty state despite existing owner
findings.cause: Membros.tsx requests user_profiles!user_id, but live user_fazendas.user_id FK points to auth.users and no direct profile FK exists
findings.impact: Owner cannot view/manage actual members or open member role administration
findings.recommendation: Adapt consumer to actual relationship using scoped profile lookup or existing supported join; distinguish request failure from empty membership. Do not add migration merely to satisfy incorrect query.

findings.preconditions: Valid pending cowboy invite, intended recipient authenticated in isolated local context
reproduction: Open invite while intended recipient authenticated
Inspect real preview response and rendered screen
findings.expected: Valid invite displays farm/role/inviter and permits acceptance
findings.observed: HTTP 200 returns one-row array with is_valid=true; screen says expired/already used, displays empty badges, no acceptance button
findings.cause: AcceptInvite.tsx assigns RPC table response directly to object-shaped invite; invite.is_valid is undefined. Existing InviteAuthContinuity mocks return object rather than actual array.
findings.impact: Blocks acceptance, role provisioning, membership administration tests and per-farm permission journey
findings.recommendation: Normalize/validate actual RPC result and handle zero rows; add contract-level regression using real table-return shape, not object-only mock.

findings.expected: Require usable contact; reject malformed email without creating invite
findings.observed: Blank contacts rejected clearly, but malformed email created persisted invitation with HTTP 200
findings.cause: Button handler only checks nonempty values; type=email alone does not validate this button-driven flow; create_invite only requires non-null contact
findings.impact: Creates unusable/misaddressed administrative records and misleading success
findings.recommendation: Validate and normalize provided contact; preserve server boundary and define accepted formats without broad new schema. Test invalid email/phone negatives.

findings.expected: New pending invite appears after creation without full reload
findings.observed: New invite absent until page reload; after reload it is shown
findings.cause: Invite success invokes loadMembers only; PendingInvites fetch effect depends on fazendaId and is not invalidated by creation
findings.impact: Owner may think invite failed and create another
findings.recommendation: Refresh/invalidate pending-invite source on successful creation; keep memberships and invite queries distinct but coordinated.

findings.preconditions: One persisted pending invite visible after reload
reproduction: Compare header count with pending card
findings.expected: Pending-invite summary agrees with persisted invite list
findings.observed: Header says 0 convite(s) while valid pending invitation is listed
findings.cause: counts.pending is computed from user_fazendas.accepted_at, not farm_invites pending source
findings.impact: Misrepresents who has been invited and who has not accepted
findings.recommendation: Derive invite summary from same scoped invitation source as pending list; do not persist a duplicate total.

findings.preconditions: Anonymous local preview request receives HTTP 401
reproduction: Open invite in fresh unauthenticated context
findings.expected: Readable error distinguishing temporary authentication/configuration failure from invalid invite
findings.observed: Screen shows [object Object] and labels valid invitation invalid
findings.cause: PostgREST error is plain object; catch converts String(error) to Error instead of extracting useful normalized message
findings.impact: Worker cannot understand or recover; recovery to root loses invitation destination
findings.recommendation: Normalize structured errors, show understandable recovery and retain invite destination; keep tokens and technical secrets out of messages.

findings.preconditions: Authenticated caller possesses valid invitation token
reproduction: Read live function definition and authenticated EXECUTE grant
Observe contact-addressed invitation model and existing membership upsert
findings.expected: Acceptance bound to intended identity and existing membership handled without unintended role overwrite
findings.observed: Live function checks login/status/expiry only; no email/phone match; on conflict overwrites role and reactivates membership
findings.cause: SECURITY DEFINER routine trusts Bearer [omitido] and performs unconditional membership upsert
findings.impact: A different authenticated account holding link can receive invited access; re-inviting existing member can overwrite current role
findings.recommendation: Define/enforce recipient binding and explicit re-invitation policy; preserve existing privileged membership, replay and transactional behavior. Add wrong-identity/already-member/owner negatives before releasing corrected acceptance.
findings.evidenceLevel: Live SQL body and grants inspected; no unauthorized membership creation or token replay exploit performed

findings.preconditions: Caller is manager in target farm; target membership may be owner
reproduction: Read live role/change/removal routines and grants
Compare UI exclusion of owner targets with backend guards
findings.expected: Backend enforce privileged-target/last-owner policy rather than relying on hidden UI action
findings.observed: Manager accepted by both routines; only assigning new owner role is restricted; target owner and last-owner checks absent. Removal targets active membership too, although UI only exposes pending removal.
findings.cause: SECURITY DEFINER UPDATE filters farm/target/deleted state but not protected target role or remaining ownership
findings.impact: Manager can logically demote/remove owner through RPC despite UI hiding owner action; ownership can be lost
findings.recommendation: Enforce explicit owner-target and last-owner protections server-side. Validate insufficient-role, protected-target and no-op cases without risking preserved owner.
findings.evidenceLevel: Static consequence of live SQL/grants/trigger inspection; owner demotion/removal not attempted

ux_recommendations.observed: Owner/Manager/Cowboy and raw cowboy shown without capability description; accept page uses separate translated mapping in code but is blocked before valid presentation.
ux_recommendations.need: Rural manager/worker understands authorization level distinct from occupation.
ux_recommendations.proposal: Consistent Proprietário/Gerente/Operador labels plus concise descriptions grounded in corrected effective contract; retain enum values.
ux_recommendations.benefit: Reduces mistaken role assignment without changing domain/security for appearance.
ux_recommendations.costRisk: Low UI cost; descriptions must wait for authorization-contract gaps to be resolved.

ux_recommendations.observed: Invite dialog is generic while farm name remains in blurred global header.
ux_recommendations.need: Know which property receives invitation/access change.
ux_recommendations.proposal: Show farm name and recipient in dialog and success/confirmation; reuse active farm context.
ux_recommendations.benefit: Prevents administrative mistakes when switching properties.
ux_recommendations.costRisk: Low presentation effort; do not create parallel tenant state.

ux_recommendations.observed: UI creates second valid invite for same recipient and also creates invite for original owner; no duplicate/member warning. Extra invitations cancelled; no association changed.
ux_recommendations.need: Understand whether to reuse, resend or change existing access.
ux_recommendations.proposal: Detect and explain existing pending invite/membership; offer copy/reissue or proper role-management flow after contracts are fixed. Do not impose physical uniqueness without agreed semantics.
ux_recommendations.benefit: Reduces duplicate invitations and accidental role overwrite.
ux_recommendations.costRisk: Low/medium query/UI cost; expiry, re-invitation and concurrency semantics need explicit decision.

ux_recommendations.observed: Error offers only Voltar para o inicio; signup recovery ends at zero-farm selector with Criar nova fazenda. Invitation had to be reopened for diagnosis.
ux_recommendations.need: Continue joining invited farm rather than assume responsibility for creating another property.
ux_recommendations.proposal: Retain invitation destination through recovery; offer retry/login/signup with context and actionable invalid/cancelled/expired messages.
ux_recommendations.benefit: Reduces abandonment and wrong next-step interpretation.
ux_recommendations.costRisk: Low/medium routing effort; no bypass of acceptance or membership rules.

ux_recommendations.observed: Pending list shows contact/role/dates but no sent-message delivery; success asks owner to share link. Member list is unavailable; joined date field exists but is not presented in card code.
ux_recommendations.need: Distinguish link generated from message sent, invitation pending from active access.
ux_recommendations.proposal: Use Link gerado — compartilhe com a pessoa; retain creation/expiry, add accepted-at when available, and fix counters before adding more indicators.
ux_recommendations.benefit: Clarifies administrative state with existing data.
ux_recommendations.costRisk: Low presentation cost after functional blockers; no new sent/delivered flags without reliable delivery source.

blockersFirst: Fix members consumer/actual relationship without turning errors into empty state
Normalize and validate preview response, including zero rows and structured error messages
Resolve recipient-binding and protected-owner/last-owner guards before releasing acceptance/admin-role operations
topThreeBenefitVersusEffort: Coordinate invitation refresh/counters with persisted source: removes demonstrated ambiguity and repeat invitations
Use consistent Portuguese role names with accurate short capability explanations after contract review
Expose farm/recipient context in dialogs and retain invite destination through error recovery
adoptionObstacles: Owner sees zero members despite being an accepted owner
Invited worker sees valid invitation called expired and cannot enter
Raw English roles, [object Object] and schema/JWT errors provide poor recovery guidance
critical_assessment.authorizationConclusions: Two live-contract critical gaps inspected, not exploited; only outsider/self-role and scoped contact negatives executed. No cowboy/manager, full RLS or cross-farm authorization approval.
critical_assessment.newData: No new mandatory field justified. Operational function may be optional later; role-history requires reliable factual source before UI claims.
rejected: Create another authorization role enum merely to translate labels
Treat professional occupation as security permission
Persist parallel member counts or farm-membership lists
Add task responsibility or work schedules without concrete operational need
Show updated_at/current role as historical administrative audit
Impose physical uniqueness for invitations without defining reissue/expiry/concurrency semantics
critical_assessment.nextJourney: J05 not started. Owner environment remains available; journeys depending on collaborator access require corrected acceptance, membership and role verification.

environment_limitations.observed: Anonymous local preview returned HTTP 401/PGRST301 JWT cryptographic operation failed. Authenticated original owner/intended recipient requests returned 200.
environment_limitations.cause: Anonymous credential/JWT-validation root cause not isolated; no environment credential/configuration changed.
environment_limitations.scope: Does not explain authenticated array/object defect and is not proof of invalid invitation.

limitations: No successful invite acceptance, rejection, already-used link, elapsed-time expiration, active-member removal, role change or live cowboy/manager module comparison.
Protected-owner and wrong-recipient critical paths inspected, never executed to mutate preserved memberships.
Anonymous JWT-validation failure root cause unresolved; no local credential or backend migration reset/reconciliation repeated.
Owner team UI and blocked invitation states tested on desktop/mobile, not physical device or virtual keyboard.
No global suite, build, lint, full baseline recertification, remote access mutation or production test; scope is local diagnosis/functional evaluation.
Some popup captures were repeated with viewport screenshots to preserve popup state; no visual defect inferred from capture timing.
